newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIAN CAPTAIN TAYLOR FAILS AGAIN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIAN CAPTAIN TAYLOR FAILS AGAIN.

text.p: Australian captain Mark Taylor's problems increased on Tuesday when he was dismissed for a duck on the opening day of the tourists' three-day match against Gloucestershire.
Taylor has said publicly he would drop himself from the Australian team if he failed to make runs in the first month of the tour.
He scored 76 in a one-day match against Northamptonshire but failed in the first two one-day internationals and stood down for the third. England won the series 3-0.
Taylor, who has not scored a 50 in his last 20 test innings, lasted only three balls on Tuesday before he was caught off the fourth by former England wicketkeeper Jack Russell off Mike Smith.
The first Ashes test against England starts on June 5.
